_instructions: Fill in this template for any new brand. Replace placeholder values. Keep all keys present. Save as audit_input.json in your client's config/ folder.
_prompts_guidance: List 14 prompts the brand cares about, balanced ~3 category / 2 comparison / 3 vertical / 2 sub-segment / 4 attribute. Each prompt is what a real user types into ChatGPT.

prompts.text: [exact user query — what someone types into ChatGPT]

baseline.drag: [reason if brand cited negatively or absent]

_buried_assets_guidance: Internal content the brand owns but doesn't surface. Newsroom press releases, peer-reviewed research, certifications, partnerships, unique features. Each should be a real URL where it currently sits, plus its strategic value.
_lifecycle_wedge_guidance: One paragraph describing the brand's structurally non-copyable claim. Often: scale + lifecycle + data history + unique product feature. This will appear in every category page the GEO Writer produces.
lifecycle_wedge: [1-2 sentences describing what makes this brand uniquely positioned — features competitors structurally cannot replicate]
